# Demox
> Demox publishes static websites and Node.js functions. HTML, ZIP, frontend builds, and documents become HTTPS sites. Node backends export handler(request, env) and attach to the same site through web, CLI, MCP, or API workflows.

## Primary pages
- [Demox homepage](https://www.demox.site/): Product overview and web deployment entry point.
- [When to use Demox](https://www.demox.site/when-to-use-demox): Fit table for static pages, Node handlers, Express, and separate backends.
- [Deploy troubleshooting](https://www.demox.site/deploy-troubleshooting): Exact error codes including MISSING_ENTRYPOINT, CONTENT_BLOCKED, INVALID_STATIC_SITE, and Access denied.
- [How Demox hosts itself](https://www.demox.site/how-demox-hosts-itself): First-party case of demox deploy plus demox functions push.
- [CLI and MCP documentation](https://www.demox.site/doc): Installation, authentication, deployment commands, functions, content scan, and FAQ.
- [Blocked phrases](https://www.demox.site/content-scan): Full local content-scan blocklist and the public list API.
- [AI static-site publishing guide](https://www.demox.site/ai-static-site-deployment): How to publish an AI-generated HTML page, ZIP, or frontend build.
- [Pricing](https://www.demox.site/pricing): Current Demox plans.

## Developer resources
- [Demox repository](https://github.com/demox-site/demox): Main web application and platform source.
- [Demox agent skill](https://github.com/demox-site/skill): Instructions for deploying with an AI coding agent, including how to list blocked phrases.
- Blocked phrases API (no auth): `GET https://api.demox.site/website/content-scan/phrases` or `POST {"action":"list_blocked_phrases"}`. Static copy: https://www.demox.site/content-scan.json
- CLI package: `@demox-site/cli`
- MCP package: `@demox-site/mcp-server`

## Supported deployment inputs
- Static build directories and ZIP archives with `index.html` at the root
- Standalone HTML pages
- PDF, Markdown, TXT, and DOCX documents
- Spreadsheet files supported by the web upload workflow

## Key distinction
Demox is for a link someone can open now, plus Node handlers on the same site. It does not claim to replace a full CI/CD platform such as Vercel or Netlify. Python, PHP, Java, and Express listen apps are not a direct fit.

This optional file helps documentation-oriented AI tools navigate Demox resources. Google Search states that `llms.txt` does not affect Google Search or its generative AI features.
